exercise_constraint: STANAG 2174 route overlay; penetration and lateral numbering
exact_quote: Each axial and lateral route will be allotted one route number, which is to be used to describe the route throughout its length.
how_it_helps: Checks consistent route IDs throughout overlay
missing_information: Route segmentation and approved route IDs
reviewer_comments: Applies to route nomenclature, not traffic capacity.

exercise_constraint: Penetration routes P111 P113 P115 and lateral routes R222 R224 R226
exact_quote: Axial routes will be given odd numbers and are shown on a tracing or map by continuous lines.
how_it_helps: Verifies odd-numbered axial routes and continuous line representation
missing_information: Authoritative line symbology and exact route network
reviewer_comments: Existing exercise labels are consistent, but depiction still needs verification.

exact_quote: Lateral routes will be given an even number and are shown on a tracing or map by broken lines.
how_it_helps: Verifies even numbering and broken-line symbology
missing_information: Overlay and authoritative route segment geometry
reviewer_comments: Not a minimum number of lateral routes.

exercise_constraint: Connectors between route sections where applicable
exact_quote: Connecting routes will be given a number formulated on b. or c. above followed by a serial number and will be shown on a tracing or map by dotted lines.
scope: Connecting routes within military route network
conditions: Only when connecting routes are shown
how_it_helps: Checks connector IDs and distinct line symbology
missing_information: Whether the design uses connecting routes
reviewer_comments: Do not classify connectors as axial or lateral automatically.

exact_quote: It must be noted that the lowest classification encountered on a route will determine the overall classification of that route.
conditions: Classification of multiple sections along same route
how_it_helps: Prevents using a better section rating as the route-wide capacity
missing_information: Section-level verified MLC and other classification measurements
reviewer_comments: MLC and tonnes are not interchangeable.

exercise_constraint: Route restrictions and obstructions in STANAG classification formula
exact_quote: If there is a temporary obstruction or single obstruction other than a bridge, or should there be special conditions described below, the overall classification will not be altered.
scope: Overall route classification when temporary or single non-bridge obstruction exists
conditions: Such obstructions or special conditions present
how_it_helps: Prevents reclassifying route solely on temporary obstruction
missing_information: Obstruction nature, location, duration; following sentence governs marking
reviewer_comments: Must be read with next sentence on inclusion in formula.

exercise_constraint: Mark temporary obstructions in route classification
exact_quote: However, these factors should be included in the route classification formula as they could affect movement over a route until conditions return to normal.
conditions: Following prior sentence: temporary/single non-bridge obstructions or special conditions
how_it_helps: Prompts recording obstructions rather than silently omitting them
reviewer_comments: The wording is should, not shall; context is preceding sentence.

exercise_constraint: Convoy movement planning and movement chart
exact_quote: Units must properly plan road movements, prepare march tables, submit movement bids, and coordinate en route support.
scope: Motor transport units planning road movements
conditions: Road movements requiring appropriate control channels
how_it_helps: Prompts checking march table, movement bid and en-route support before scheduling
missing_information: Route control category; format/authority for local approvals
reviewer_comments: Does not set numeric speed or spacing.

exact_quote: The classifications specify the degree of control required and whether moving units must submit a movement bid (clearance request) to use a route.
scope: MSR and ASR route classifications in highway regulation plan
how_it_helps: Identifies clearance decisions omitted from pure travel-time calculations
missing_information: Current approved highway-regulation plan and movement permissions
reviewer_comments: Different from STANAG physical route classification.

exact_quote: The highway regulation plan will specify the size of convoys or types of vehicles that require a movement credit.
scope: Supervised routes in highway regulation plan
conditions: Depends on convoy size and vehicle type
how_it_helps: Flags conditional authorization for particular convoys
reviewer_comments: Context: supervised-route paragraph; no universal convoy-size threshold.

exact_quote: A movement credit is required for the movement of any vehicle or group of vehicles.
conditions: Only where route formally classified as a dispatch route
how_it_helps: Flags required approval independently of speed timetable
missing_information: Route classification and issued movement credit
reviewer_comments: Never apply universally to all roads.

exercise_constraint: Deconflicting junction occupancy and route flow
exact_quote: Routes should be planned to accommodate the traffic volume anticipated during these operations.
how_it_helps: Supports examining congestion and route-capacity mismatch
missing_information: Volumes, traffic demand and junction capacities
reviewer_comments: Qualitative should, not a numerical capacity.

exact_quote: Movements crossing movement control boundaries should be inbound-cleared in advance with the movement control organization serving the destination area.
conditions: Only if the movement crosses such a boundary
how_it_helps: Adds advance coordination check for inter-area movement
missing_information: Boundary locations and receiving movement-control authority
reviewer_comments: Recommendation in this text; no proof routes cross boundaries.

exact_quote: Traffic control using MPs or HN police should be set up at critical points and congested areas.
scope: Critical points and congested areas on motor transport routes
conditions: Congestion / critical point present; personnel available
how_it_helps: Supports flagging coordination needs around junctions
missing_information: Critical point locations, personnel availability, local approval
reviewer_comments: Should is advisory; not a prescribed number of personnel.

exact_quote: The convoy must clear the RP and get off the route with a minimum of delay to prevent congestion with other scheduled movements.
conditions: After reaching release point during a scheduled movement
how_it_helps: Adds exit-flow checks to convoy movement charts
missing_information: Release-point placement, capacity, and egress paths
reviewer_comments: Do not confuse RP with destination or stopping point.
